# SECTION 1: SYSTEM OVERVIEW & STACK
[PROJECT IDENTITY]
- Name: Recetaria API (MVP Backend)
- Goal: RESTful API for recipe sharing, enhanced by strict role-based clinical and culinary validation (RBAC).
- Core Value: Bridges user-generated content (UGC) with verification from Nutritionists and Chefs.

[TECHNOLOGY STACK]
- Runtime: Node.js (v18+)
- Language: TypeScript (Strict mode enabled, no implicit any)
- Web Framework: Express.js
- Database: PostgreSQL (v15+)
- ORM: Prisma ORM (v5+)
- Schema Validation: Zod
- Security & Cryptography: Bcrypt (Password hashing, salt rounds >= 10), JSON Web Tokens (JWT, stateless Bearer auth)
- Testing & QA: Vitest / Jest, Supertest, Thunder Client Collections


# SECTION 2: MACRO ARCHITECTURE & LAYER RULES
[4-LAYER ARCHITECTURAL PATTERN]
Architecture follows a feature-modular layered monolith:
Client Request -> Express Router -> Middleware Pipeline -> Controller -> Service -> Repository (Prisma) -> PostgreSQL

[LAYER RESPONSIBILITIES]
1. ROUTER (src/modules/*/router.ts):
   - Maps URL paths and HTTP verbs.
   - Applies middleware sequence: Zod validation -> JWT authentication -> RBAC authorization.
   - Zero business logic allowed in routers.

2. MIDDLEWARES (src/middlewares/*):
   - validateMiddleware: Intercepts req.body, req.query, req.params using Zod schemas. Emits 400 Bad Request on failure.
   - authMiddleware: Verifies Bearer JWT from Authorization header. Attaches user context to req.user = { id: string, role: Role }.
   - rbacMiddleware(roles: Role[]): Asserts req.user.role is within permitted list. Emits 403 Forbidden on violation.
   - errorHandlerMiddleware: Global catch-all preventing Node.js process crashes, outputting standardized JSend 500 envelopes.

3. CONTROLLER (src/modules/*/controller.ts):
   - Handles HTTP protocol concerns (req, res).
   - Extracts validated parameters and DTOs.
   - Delegates business execution to the corresponding Service.
   - Every method MUST be wrapped in a try/catch block.
   - Formats and emits standardized JSend JSON envelopes.

4. SERVICE (src/modules/*/service.ts):
   - Encapsulates 100% of business logic and invariants.
   - Performs domain checks (e.g. recipe status transitions, ownership verification).
   - Coordinates multi-entity ACID transactions via Prisma $transaction.
   - INVIOLABLE RULE: Services NEVER instantiate or invoke Prisma Client directly. They must exclusively call Repositories.

5. REPOSITORY (src/modules/*/repository.ts):
   - Isolates Prisma Client and direct database communication.
   - Provides strongly-typed CRUD and query methods.


# SECTION 3: UNIVERSAL RESPONSE CONTRACT (JSEND EXTENDED)
All API endpoints return JSON conforming strictly to the JSend standard envelope:

[SUCCESS RESPONSE (HTTP 200, 201)]
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Operación ejecutada exitosamente",
  "data": { ... } | [ ... ]
}

[ERROR RESPONSE (HTTP 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500)]
{
  "success": false,
  "statusCode": 400,
  "message": "Descripción clara del error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "field": "prepTimeMinutes",
      "message": "El tiempo de preparación debe ser mayor a 0"
    }
  ]
}


# SECTION 4: DATA MODEL & RELATIONAL SCHEMA (PostgreSQL / Prisma)
[ENUMS]
- Role: USER | CHEF | NUTRITIONIST | ADMIN
- RecipeStatus: DRAFT | PENDING_REVIEW | APPROVED | REJECTED | ARCHIVED
- Difficulty: EASY | MEDIUM | HARD | EXPERT

[DATABASE TABLES]
TABLE users (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  passwordHash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  firstName VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  lastName VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  role Role NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USER',
  isActive BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  createdAt TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updatedAt TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

TABLE recipes (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  title VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  slug VARCHAR(200) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  difficulty Difficulty NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MEDIUM',
  status RecipeStatus NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
  prepTimeMinutes SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (prepTimeMinutes > 0),
  tags VARCHAR(50)[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  ingredients JSONB NOT NULL,
  nutritionalInfo JSONB,
  coverImageUrl VARCHAR(512),
  videoUrl VARCHAR(512),
  authorId UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  reviewedById UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  publishedAt TIMESTAMPTZ,
  createdAt TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updatedAt TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

TABLE sessions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  userId UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  refreshToken VARCHAR(512) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  ipAddress VARCHAR(45),
  userAgent TEXT,
  expiresAt TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

TABLE audit_logs (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  entityName VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  entityId UUID NOT NULL,
  action VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  userId UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  oldValues JSONB,
  newValues JSONB,
  createdAt TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

[DATABASE TRIGGERS & FUNCTIONS]
- Function update_updated_at_column(): Automatically sets NEW."updatedAt" = NOW() on table update.
- Triggers: trg_users_updated_at on users, trg_recipes_updated_at on recipes.

[INDEXES]
- idx_users_email: users(email) [B-Tree Unique]
- idx_users_role_isactive: users(role, isActive) [B-Tree]
- idx_recipes_slug: recipes(slug) [B-Tree Unique]
- idx_recipes_status_diff: recipes(status, difficulty) [B-Tree Composite]
- idx_recipes_authorid: recipes(authorId) [B-Tree]
- idx_sessions_userid: sessions(userId) [B-Tree]
- idx_audit_logs_entity: audit_logs(entityName, entityId) [B-Tree]


# SECTION 5: BUSINESS RULES & STATE MACHINE
[RECIPE LIFE CYCLE]
1. Creation: Starts in status = 'DRAFT', authorId set to authenticated user (req.user.id).
2. Ownership: Only the user matching recipe.authorId can execute PUT /recipes/:id.
3. Deletion: Only recipe author or ADMIN can execute DELETE /recipes/:id.
4. Approval (PUT /recipes/:id/approve):
   - Restricted to CHEF and NUTRITIONIST roles (RBAC).
   - Must be executed inside a single Prisma $transaction:
     a) Update recipes SET status = 'APPROVED', reviewedById = req.user.id, publishedAt = NOW().
     b) Insert into audit_logs (entityName='Recipe', entityId=recipe.id, action='APPROVE', userId=req.user.id, newValues={"status":"APPROVED"}).


# SECTION 6: API ENDPOINTS SPECIFICATION (/api/v1)
[MODULE: AUTH]
- POST /api/v1/auth/register
  Access: Public
  Request Body: { email, password (min 8), firstName, lastName, role? }
  Success: 201 Created -> { id, email, role }
  Errors: 400 Bad Request (Validation failed), 409 Conflict (Email already in use)

- POST /api/v1/auth/login
  Access: Public
  Request Body: { email, password }
  Success: 200 OK -> { token, user: { id, email, role } }
  Errors: 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized (Invalid credentials)

[MODULE: RECIPES]
- GET /api/v1/recipes
  Access: Public
  Query Params: ?status=APPROVED&difficulty=EASY
  Success: 200 OK -> Array of recipe cards

- GET /api/v1/recipes/:id
  Access: Public
  URL Param: id (UUIDv4)
  Success: 200 OK -> Full recipe detail
  Errors: 400 Bad Request (Invalid UUID format), 404 Not Found

- POST /api/v1/recipes
  Access: Protected (USER, CHEF, NUTRITIONIST)
  Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>
  Request Body: { title, description, difficulty, prepTimeMinutes (>0), tags, ingredients, nutritionalInfo?, coverImageUrl? }
  Success: 201 Created -> Created recipe entity in DRAFT status
  Errors: 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized

- PUT /api/v1/recipes/:id
  Access: Protected (Author owner only)
  Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>
  Success: 200 OK -> Updated recipe entity
  Errors: 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden (Not recipe author), 404 Not Found

- DELETE /api/v1/recipes/:id
  Access: Protected (Author owner or ADMIN)
  Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>
  Success: 200 OK -> Deletion confirmation
  Errors: 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found

- PUT /api/v1/recipes/:id/approve
  Access: Protected (CHEF, NUTRITIONIST only)
  Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>
  Success: 200 OK -> Approved recipe entity + AuditLog entry
  Errors: 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden (USER cannot approve), 404 Not Found


# SECTION 7: AI AGENT GOVERNANCE & INTERACTION
[GOVERNANCE POLICY: ALWAYS, ASK, NEVER]
- ALWAYS: Strongly type with TypeScript (no any), validate all inputs with Zod, wrap controllers in try/catch, format responses with JSend.
- ASK: Modifying database migrations, executing destructive Git commands, altering folder structures, modifying package.json dependencies.
- NEVER: NEVER TOUCH OR COMMIT .env. Never expose credentials, API keys or database URLs. Never bypass role checks or Zod validation.
